versions.changelog:
Initial release of teaching-app-builder.

- Converts teaching text or concepts into a single-file interactive HTML teaching app.
- Output is a fully self-contained .html file: double-click to open in browser, no server or build process required.
- Libraries are loaded from China-accessible CDNs (BootCDN, staticfile, 360, npmmirror).
- Six built-in professional color schemes, easily switchable.
- Multiple interactive components supported: charts, diagrams, formulas, SVG, quizzes, tabs, steps, etc., mapped to content needs.
- Strict adherence to original teaching content; no fabrication of facts or data.
